description: Fork of exp207 (val_bpb=1.7482 @ 8K, 87M). Single change: E 384 -> 192. Derived changes: E_H = 192/6 = 32, D = E*log2(E) = 192*7.585 ~= 1456 (was 3297), tok_emb/head params halve, Wq/Wk/Wv halve. LUT shape (nap=6, tph=1536, n_sparse=32, n_alt=1, smooth=True) unchanged but input_dim halves. tph keeps high pair-coverage relative to smaller (E*(E-1)/2 = 18336) pair space. Total ~56M params (down from 87M). Aim: see if smaller E hurts the LUT-LM on its own.
